posts.name: Edwin
posts.cooked:
1.  When Friction plays the top card of each Vengeance villain deck, does she start or end with her own deck?

2.  When Advanced Mad Bomber Blade puts cards from his deck under his character card, do they go face-up or face-down?

posts.name: jffdougan
posts.cooked:
When I've played Vengeance games, I've had Friction go in turn order.

For Mad Bomber Blade, it shouldn't matter -- they're just increasing his damage count.

posts.name: Edwin
posts.cooked:
jffdougan:

When I've played Vengeance games, I've had Friction go in turn order.

IMO, if the order is Blade - Friction - Ermine - Train, it doesn't make much sense to start with playing Blade's card when his turn just ended, so there's still the question of whether you continue in turn order starting from Friction, or starting from the villain just downstream from Friction (Ermine in this example).

For Mad Bomber Blade, it shouldn't matter – they're just increasing his damage count.

It could be very important to players' strategy to know whether, for example, any Hasten Dooms still remain in Blade's deck, or if there's a chance they'll have to discard to Consider the Price of Victory, or whether Blade might gain HP from Flesh-Repair Nannites.  As widely varied as Blade's strategy is, knowing which options he's expended until his next reshuffle is a significant advantage.

posts.name: Edwin
posts.cooked: When something is told to happen in turn order, I assume that means "proceeding from now in turn order", not "jumping from now to the start of an arbitrary round-division".  Like, Atlantean Font of Power says to play the top card of each hero deck in turn order, so if Rook City Wraith puts it into play during her turn, and if we pretend it said "when this enters play" rather than "at end of environment turn", I'd assume that Wraith would be the first hero to drink from it, or possibly the last (although I agree that the first feels more logical, so I believe that's how I'll play Synergy Surge henceforth, even though it's a bit more annoying to have to remember what might be a very long chain).  I'm sure there's a better example there but that's the one I can think of.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked: Erm, the round division isn't "arbitrary"...the round starts with the villain turn, proceeds through each hero in whatever order you've decided upon when the game starts, and ends with the environment turn. Thus, anything happening "in turn order" will start with whichever applicable deck is first in said order.
